# PickMyApp

> Honest guides, comparisons and reviews of business software. We check vendor pricing pages, test free plans where possible, take no paid placements, and note the date every price was checked.

If only one file is slow, the workbook itself is bloated — clear conditional formatting, reset the used range, and save as .xlsb.
